gloss: eating oneself into ruin; Osaka's food culture

definitions.gloss: eating oneself into ruin; spending all one's money on food
definitions.explanation: Spending so much on food and dining that one goes broke. Describes a lifestyle of prioritizing eating to an extreme degree.

definitions.gloss: Osaka's reputation as a food capital
definitions.explanation: A cultural nickname for Osaka, famous for the saying {大阪|おおさか}の{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ (Osaka's eat-till-you-drop culture). Refers to the city's reputation for abundant, affordable, and delicious food.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to Osaka, the city of eat-till-you-drop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Osaka is known as the food-lovers' city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、{食|く}い{倒|だお}れになってしまう。
examples.english: If you keep eating out every night, you'll eat yourself into ruin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦たこ{焼|や}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧や⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満喫|まんきつ}→満喫：19576_mankitsu⟧してきた。
examples.english: I went to Osaka on a trip and fully enjoyed the eat-till-you-drop food culture, with takoyaki and okonomiyaki.

examples.japanese: {京|きょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着倒|きだお}れ、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ。
examples.english: Kyoto spends itself on clothing; Osaka on food.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き→食べ歩き：15117_tabearuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the spirit of eat-till-you-drop, I spent from morning to night eating my way through one neighborhood.

notes:
Compound of {食|く}い (eating) + {倒|だお}れ (falling down/going bankrupt). Part of a famous set of sayings about Japanese cities.

FAMOUS SAYING:
{京|きょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着倒|きだお}れ、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ — Kyoto bankrupts you with clothing, Osaka with food. This saying captures the cultural priorities of each city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ (the food city, i.e., Osaka)
- {食|く}い{倒|だお}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満喫|まんきつ}→満喫：19576_mankitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (fully enjoy the food culture)
- ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ (Osaka's eat-till-you-drop reputation)

USAGE:
The famous くいだおれ{太郎|たろう} (Kuidaore Tarō) is a mechanical clown figure on Osaka's Dōtonbori street, one of the city's most recognizable landmarks. While the original restaurant closed in 2008, the figure remains a popular tourist photo spot.
